note: Clorpropamide (CPA), polimorfo delta sotto compressione idrostatica in DAC (cristallo singolo, SCXRD): delta -> fase incommensurabilmente modulata delta'inc -> fase commensurata delta''HP (b triplicato), con la pressione di trasformazione che dipende dal protocollo (tempo di permanenza in pressione, tipo di sorgente). Quattro serie: (1) laboratorio Gemini, dati troppo scadenti per dire se c'e' una transizione («too large to even conclude reliably whether a polymorphic transition occurred»: nessun evento); (2) BM01 ESRF; (3) ID27 ESRF (anche decompressione); (4) laboratorio Synergy-S (17 h per punto, 72 h a 2.37 GPa). Eventi 'citati' da altri lavori (tabelle 1 e 2 e introduzione): solo quelli con un numero o un refcode (ε per riscaldamento 398 K, β -> βII -> βIII in raffreddamento, ε -> ε', α -> α' a 2.9 GPa, delta Raman 2.4-3.3 GPa). Non sono eventi: l'analisi della deformazione (PasCal, WinStrain), le compressibilita' lungo gli assi, le curve a, b, c contro P, la statistica sul vettore di modulazione q contro P (Fig. 10) e le considerazioni sulla possibile stabilita' di delta'inc («the intermediate incommensurate phase could possibly be metastable or thermodynamically stable in a narrow pressure range»). CONFLITTI interni: (a) la pressione a cui a BM01 si osserva delta'inc: 2.03-2.59 GPa (risultati, 'phase transition ... in the pressure range 2.03 (5)-2.59 (5) GPa'; satelliti per la prima volta a 2.59 (5) GPa), ma piu' avanti «the data collected at BM01 allowed us to solve the structure at 2.37 (5) GPa only» e nelle conclusioni 2.03-2.37 GPa; si tiene 2.03-2.59 per BM01 e 2.37 per ID27; (b) la pressione di formazione di delta''HP a BM01: 3.51 (5) GPa (sezione sulla cinetica, discussione dei dati di cella) contro 3.70 (5) GPa (q = 0.33 raggiunto, struttura modello, sezione strain); si tiene 3.51; (c) i datablock del CIF riportano 2.02, 0.26, 2.59 e 3.6 GPa, il testo 2.03 (5), 2.59 (5) e 3.70 (5) GPa. I CCDC 2523428-2523431 sono attribuiti ai 4 datablock (global escluso) per ordine con ccdc_dedotto: 2523428 = deltaCPA2.59GPa (delta'inc), 2523429 = deltaCPA2.02GPa (delta), 2523430 = deltaCPA0.26GPa (delta), 2523431 = deltaCPA3.6GPa (delta''HP). Le pressioni di queste strutture non hanno un campo in strutture[] e sono scritte nelle note delle forme.

gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: The positional modulation of the 4-chlorobenzene molecular fragment could be decomposed into two components: (1) discontinuous rotation around the [011] direction by ∼10°, corresponding to the interchange between the ‘a’ and ‘b’ orientations of the fragment (Figure S3), and (2) continuous rotation around the S1–Cl1a(Cl1b) axis by ∼20° for the ‘a’ fragment and ∼30° for the ‘b’ fragment (Fig. 7 ▸).

The discontinuous modulation of the terminal propyl fragment is described by switching between ‘a’ and ‘b’ orientations so that the angle between the normal to the C8–C9a(C9b)–C10a(C10b) plane and the S1–N1 direction changes from ∼10° to ∼70°, respectively.

citazioni: The experiments revealed a phase transition to an incommensurately modulated phase in the pressure range 2.03 (5)–2.59 (5) GPa (denoted as the δ′inc-CPA phase).
At the first pressure point where satellite reflections were observed [2.59 (5) GPa] the modulation vector q = 0.28 (1)b*.
The parameters a and c underwent an abrupt change at 2.59 (5) GPa, simultaneously with the first observation of satellite reflections during the phase transition.
The time separating the measurements at selected pressure points in this series of experiments was about 1.5 h.
The 50 × 50 × 15 µm sample was loaded in an Almax-Boehler DAC with opening angles of 2θ = 80°.
eventi.note: Serie BM01 (ESRF), mezzo di pressione pentano–isopentano 1:1 come nella serie 1 («the gasket material and pressure-transmitting medium were the same as described above for the first series of experiments»). Forchetta = ultimo punto senza satelliti (2.03 (5) GPa, modello non modulato) e primo con satelliti (2.59 (5) GPa). Il tempo fra due punti di misura (circa 1.5 h) e' un dato che l'articolo usa per spiegare la differenza fra i protocolli. Transizione di tipo 'lock-in' secondo l'articolo (formazione brusca della struttura incommensurata, poi q evolve monotonicamente). Vedi la nota dell'articolo per il conflitto 2.37 / 2.59 GPa.
eventi.conflitto: Pressione di comparsa di δ'inc a BM01: 'in the pressure range 2.03 (5)-2.59 (5) GPa' e primi satelliti a 2.59 (5) GPa nei risultati; piu' avanti «the data collected at BM01 allowed us to solve the structure at 2.37 (5) GPa only»; nelle conclusioni 'within the pressure range of 2.03 (5) to 2.37 (5) GPa'. Si tiene l'intervallo dei risultati.

gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: The commensurate modulation of the high-pressure δ′′HP phase is related to the variation in the positions of the terminal propyl molecular fragments, as well as to the rotation of the aromatic rings with respect to the N–C–N axis (Figs. 4 ▸ and 11).

The commensurate modulation of the high-pressure δ′′HP phase is related to the variation in the positions of the terminal propyl molecular fragments, as well as to the rotation of the aromatic rings with respect to the N–C–N axis (Figs. 4 ▸ and 11).
This is the direction along which the N2—H2⋯O2 and N1—H1⋯O3 hydrogen bonds are formed in the structure (Figure S2).
This phase can be described in terms of a superstructure; the space group and crystal-structure-forming motif are similar to the original structure.

citazioni: As pressure increased further, the value of the modulation vector increased monotonically, reaching q = 0.33 (1)b* at 3.70 (5) GPa, which corresponds to the formation of a commensurately modulated superstructure – denoted here as the δ′′HP-CPA phase.
The changes along the b axis were continuous up to 3.51 (5) GPa, above which the crystal structure could be described using a periodic model with a tripled b parameter.

This fact may also explain why the formation of the commensurately modulated high-pressure phase (δ′′HP) was observed at different pressures during synchrotron experiments at BM01 and ID27: 3.51 (5) GPa at BM01 and 4.9 (1) GPa at ID27.
The time separating the measurements at selected pressure points in this series of experiments was about 1.5 h.
eventi.note: Il fatto che il motivo costitutivo resti e' dichiarato nelle conclusioni per δ''HP rispetto alla struttura originale. La lunghezza dell'asse b ha un minimo a 3.51 (5) GPa e poi cresce (ordine dei frammenti flessibili e loro spostamento). Sopra 4.04 (5) GPa il cristallo si degrada (E11).
eventi.conflitto: Pressione di formazione di δ''HP a BM01: 3.51 (5) GPa (primo punto con modello periodico a b triplicato, e confronto fra sorgenti) contro 3.70 (5) GPa (q = 0.33 (1)b* raggiunto, struttura modello, sezione sullo strain). Si tiene 3.51 (5) GPa, il valore usato dall'articolo per confrontare le sorgenti.

citazioni: At 2.37 (5) GPa, satellite reflections along the b axis were observed, confirming the formation of the intermediate incommensurately modulated phase previously discovered at BM01. The modulation vector q = 0.29 (1)b* was also in agreement with previous results.
Owing to the use of significantly shorter wavelength radiation in combination with membrane-driven high-pressure cells, the time between pressure points was reduced to less than an hour.
The 50 × 50 × 15 µm sample was loaded in a membrane-driven DAC equipped with Almax-Boehler type anvils with opening angles 2θ = 64°.
eventi.note: Serie ID27 (ESRF, undulatore, 33 keV), cella a membrana; stesso mezzo di pressione delle serie precedenti. Tempo fra i punti di pressione inferiore a un'ora.

citazioni: However, the δ′′HP phase formation was observed at 4.9 (1) GPa, which is significantly higher than in the BM01 experiment.

With increasing pressure, the modulation vector increased monotonically to q = 0.33 (1)b*, corresponding to the formation of a high-pressure commensurately modulated phase, which could be described in terms of a superstructure with a tripled b parameter, confirming the results obtained in the second series of experiments.
Owing to the use of significantly shorter wavelength radiation in combination with membrane-driven high-pressure cells, the time between pressure points was reduced to less than an hour.

citazioni: When releasing pressure in the DAC, the high-pressure commensurately modulated phase (δ′′HP) remained stable at pressures above 2.84 (5) GPa, while on reducing the pressure further to 2.20 (5) GPa, the initial δ-CPA phase reappeared. On decompression, the δ′′HP commensurately modulated phase transformed directly to δ-CPA, without the formation of the incommensurately modulated intermediate phase.

A BM01 la decompressione non e' stata fatta.

citazioni: The initial pressure value was set as 1.94 (5) – insufficient for a phase transition. Only reflections expected from the ‘normal’ δ-CPA model were detected during the pre-experiment.

eventi.note: Lavoro citato. 2.9 GPa e' la pressione della struttura di α′ (Tabella 2), non la pressione di transizione, che il testo non dice. Il mezzo di pressione di quel lavoro non e' detto qui.

citazioni: Analysis of the Raman spectra of a crystal of δ-CPA on hydrostatic compression in a pentane–isopentane mixture in a diamond anvil cell (DAC) has revealed a reversible structural transformation upon increasing the pressure from 2.4 (1) to 3.3 (1) GPa (Zakharov, Goryainov & Boldyreva, 2016 ▸).
eventi.note: Lavoro citato: la fase di arrivo non e' strutturalmente identificata in quel lavoro («The aim of the present work was to solve the structure of this high-pressure phase»), quindi a: ignota. Reversibile secondo la frase, senza condizioni per il ritorno.

citazioni: 47 mg of α-chlorpropamide (>97%, Sigma) were dissolved in 1 ml of heptane and brought to boiling.
preparazioni.note: α-chlorpropamide commerciale (Sigma, >97 %), usato come materiale di partenza per ottenere i cristalli di δ.

citazioni: 47 mg of α-chlorpropamide (>97%, Sigma) were dissolved in 1 ml of heptane and brought to boiling. Subsequently, 0.5 ml of ethyl acetate was added dropwise. Upon complete dissolution, the mixture was rapidly cooled in an ice bath at 0°C. The resulting precipitate (37 mg) was filtered on a glass filter. The single crystals were obtained as thin (less than 10 µm) transparent colorless plates, their maximum size not exceeding 250 µm.
preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 47 mg in 1 ml of heptane, then 0.5 ml of ethyl acetate
preparazioni.note: La parte sperimentale non nomina la forma ottenuta: i cristalli sono quelli del polimorfo δ studiati nelle serie di misura (abstract: «The densest polymorph, δ-CPA, was probed by single-crystal X-ray diffraction»). Attribuzione a δ per il contesto.

citazioni: The experiments revealed a phase transition to an incommensurately modulated phase in the pressure range 2.03 (5)–2.59 (5) GPa (denoted as the δ′inc-CPA phase).
At 2.37 (5) GPa, satellite reflections along the b axis were observed, confirming the formation of the intermediate incommensurately modulated phase previously discovered at BM01.
preparazioni.note: Fase intermedia osservata solo in compressione al sincrotrone (BM01, ID27).

citazioni: The structural transformation was observed at different pressures depending on the pressure-increasing protocol and the time during which the sample remained under pressure exceeding 2.37 (5) GPa.
preparazioni.note: Si ottiene da δ per compressione idrostatica in DAC, direttamente (laboratorio, tempi lunghi) o via δ'inc (sincrotrone, tempi brevi).

descrizioni.testo: diversity of the conformational polymorphs from the orientation of the aromatic ring and the alkyl terminal group relative to the rigid core (type I or type II), the conformation of the C3H8 fragment, and the orientation of neighboring hydrogen-bonded chains (Z or π motif)
descrizioni.citazione: The structural diversity of the conformational polymorphs arises from the changes in the orientation of the aromatic ring and the alkyl terminal group with respect to the ‘rigid core’ of the molecule (type I or type II,1 Fig. 1 ▸), the conformation of the C3H8 fragment itself, and variations of the orientation of the neighboring hydrogen-bonded chains with respect to each other (Z or π motif, Fig. 2 ▸) (Drebushchak, Drebushchak & Boldyreva, 2011 ▸).

descrizioni.testo: CPA is prone to conformational polymorphism, often related to an increase in the number of symmetry-independent molecules and/or structural modulation
descrizioni.citazione: CPA is prone to conformational polymorphism, which is often related to an increase in the number of symmetry-independent molecules and/or structural modulation (Fig. 12 ▸).

descrizioni.testo: three symmetry-inequivalent molecules of conformation type I with N2–C8–C9–C10 torsions of −45.14 (2)°, −58.83 (2)° and −63.64 (2)° (initial value −50.90 (8)° at ambient pressure)
descrizioni.citazione: At 3.70 (5) GPa, the values for the torsion angles N2–C8–C9–C10 of the three symmetry-inequivalent molecules of the asymmetric unit used to describe the conformation of type I differ significantly for all the three molecules from the initial value of −50.90 (8)° at ambient pressure, and are equal to −45.14 (2)°, −58.83 (2)° and −63.64 (2)°.

descrizioni.testo: sequence of molecular conformations along the modulation vector (not the same from one unit cell to another); atoms of the 4-chlorobenzene and propyl fragments split into ‘a’ and ‘b’ counterparts
descrizioni.citazione: The conformation and atomic coordinates of the symmetry-independent molecules are the same from one unit cell to another in δ′′HP; however, for δ′inc this is not true: a sequence of molecular conformations is observed along the modulation vector.
